paragraphs.text: Alchemy: Eldraine is a MTG Arena -exclusive card set in the Alchemy -series that was released on October 10, 2023.

Alchemy: Eldraine is a digital only release adjacent to the release of Wilds of Eldraine . There are 30 new designed-for-digital cards included in the set (10 uncommons, 15 rares, 5 mythic rares) . All of the cards are set on Eldraine .
paragraphs.section: Description

paragraphs.text: The digital-only mechanics Conjure , Double team , Perpetually , Seek and Spellbook are reused. From the main set, Bargain , Celebration and the Wicked Role are used.
paragraphs.section: Mechanics

paragraphs.text: Drover of the Swine , Porcine Portent and Swine Rebellion are the first cards to share a spellbook, and introduce named spellbooks.
paragraphs.section: Mechanics

paragraphs.text: The set re-introduces Fetch counters for the first time since Commander 2020 . Boons are modified so they can be used multiple times and the previously existing versions are re-titled "One-time boon". Alchemy: Eldraine doesn't make use of this new format but does contain the first instances of one-time boons.

paragraphs.section: Misprints

paragraphs.text: The Into the Future event associated with Alchemy: Eldraine was held on Magic: The Gathering Arena from October 10 to 12, 2023. It featured five phantom preconstructed decks intended to highlight how new cards could be used in the Alchemy format.
